dogecoin.text: @mmadelynsmith @redditships My son ended up in a position where he needed to invest $15 in something, so he bought Dogecoin. This was a while before it became a "thing." He sold when it hit like $100, and he was pleased. That's cute. This post...is not.

@redditships I admit to not understanding NFTs, Dogecoin, etc, but doesn't this sound like a gambling addiction? He can't seem to stop, and he keeps needing to throw in more money to make it right even after she's told him she hates that he's doing this.
